title: A pilot repository outside KRN delivers five tasks through krn lane run
body:
Why: every KRN task so far is KRN-on-KRN; both audits (Fable, Qwen 4) name an outside pilot as the real product test. Operator 2026-11-11 granted the lead the choice of pilot repository and its onboarding (memory:lead-decides). Decision record: .krn/runs/pilot/decision.md (pick: korneliuszburian/seo-audit-harness at /mnt/storage/coding/krn/active/seo-audit).
Outcome: the pilot is onboarded with krn adopt through a PR in its own repository (never pushing its default branch, never editing the operator's checkout), krn lane run delivers 5 real pilot tasks, and their correctness is graded by hidden tests in the t-ahepzts grader shape.
Proof: 5 merged pilot PRs listed with lane $, lead turns and hidden-test verdicts in this task; Qwen N10 portability blockers (App token repositories:['krn'], hard-coded paths) fixed in KRN first.

Token scope (2026-11-11): scripts/github-app-token.ts mints for KRN_APP_REPOSITORY=<owner/name> via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/installation. Live: korneliuszburian/seo-audit-harness answers 404, the App krn-works-delivery is not installed there; the operator installs it (repository-only selection) before krn lane run can push or ship. Remaining N10 items: Check aggregate name (pilot CI is 'CI'), origin/main assumption, npm run fast in lane-run.
Depends on the portability tasks t-9xwtz6f t-p226jft t-pvhs4eb  (operator 2026-11-13: KRN must work in any repository); add a second pilot in another stack (Python) graded the same way.
Portability tasks: t-9xwtz6f contract, t-p226jft Stop check, t-pvhs4eb lane, t-d25znwp adopt, t-0a9xgwe universal skills/rules.

Blocker (2026-11-13, lead): App krn-works-delivery is private (GET /apps/krn-works-delivery unauthenticated: 404), so it can only be installed on the krn-works org; korneliuszburian/seo-audit-harness is a personal-account repo and the bot token gets 404 (git ls-remote: repository not found). No operator token is reachable on this host (gh keyring call answers 'Resource not accessible by integration'). The App bot cannot create krn-works repos (no administration permission). Operator action needed, one of: (1, recommended) App settings > Make public, then install on korneliuszburian with Only select repositories = seo-audit-harness; (2) transfer seo-audit-harness to krn-works (all-repositories installation covers it; old URLs redirect); (3) create an empty private krn-works/krn-pilot repo and the lead seeds it.

Progress 2026-11-13 (lead): N10 check name fixed in #678 (3bb655b): spec/ci-admission.json names any aggregate, krn adopt --ref writes 'ci / Check' and puts the shared CI call in krn-ci.yml beside an existing ci.yml. Origin/main and npm run fast items were already contract-driven (src/cli/pr.ts contractBase, src/cli/lane-run.ts contract.fast). Pilot gate in a local clone (/mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/seo-audit from the operator checkout, stale 94 commits): npm ci 0, npm run verify 1 with 1688/1691 tests passing (2 timeouts under host load, 1 serve profile assertion). Dry adopt in the clone writes the full set with explicit --install/--lint/--typecheck/--test 'npm --prefix packages/seo ...'; auto-detection miss is t-g9m2svp. Remaining: operator App action (Blocker above), then adopt PR in the pilot and 5 lane runs; second stack (Python) pilot not yet picked.
